metadata.scope: Make the existing verify-no-localhost-bake CI workflow enforceable as a required status check on dev/main branch protection. Root-cause optimization vs the stale unassigned proto-spec: (1) the proto-spec assumed already-registered contexts (audit-correlation-verify / verify-design-tokens / playwright-smoke) that do NOT match current branch protection (actual: ci / Validate Build / coverage-gate / lighthouse-ci / e2e-tests-coverage-gate); (2) verify-no-localhost-bake.yml carries an on.pull_request.paths filter, so registering it as-is would leave PRs that do not touch apps/web/src in a permanent Waiting-for-status block. Therefore the spec adds a small code change — remove the pull_request.paths filter so the gate always runs (matching the no-paths convention of every existing required check) — and then registers the verify-no-localhost-bake context into the dev and main required_status_checks.contexts via gh api -X PUT (user-gated), preserving existing contexts and asserting no governance drift.
metadata.runtime_boundary: The Phase 1-13 task spec and local yml paths-filter removal are complete in this cycle. No branch-protection mutation, commit, push, PR, or Issue mutation is executed here. The read-only branch-protection GET evidence is allowed pre-gate. gh api -X PUT branch-protection mutation (dev/main), commit, push, and PR are user-gated.
metadata.implementationDivisionRationale: User-supplied source (unassigned proto-spec) framed AC-5/AC-7 as 'gate body unchanged'. Reality (CONST_004 実態優先): a required status check must always run, but verify-no-localhost-bake.yml has an on.pull_request.paths filter that suppresses the run on non-web PRs, which would permanently block merge. The grep LOGIC in scripts/verify-no-localhost-bake.sh stays unchanged, but the workflow trigger MUST be broadened (remove pull_request.paths). That is a code change to .github/workflows/verify-no-localhost-bake.yml, so this is an 実装仕様書, not docs-only.
verify_commands: mise exec -- pnpm vitest run scripts/verify-no-localhost-bake.spec.ts

gh api -X PUT branches/main/protection (required status check registration)
